                    e.printStackTrace();
                }
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }
        
        long nextLong() {
            return Long.parseLong(next());

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class WeightChecker {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        try (BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in))) {
            String[] parts = br.readLine().trim().split("\\s+");
            long w = Long.parseLong(parts[0]);
            long m = Long.parseLong(parts[1]);
            
            System.out.println(check(w, m) ? "YES" : "NO");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            System.out.println("NO");
        }
    }
    
    static boolean check(long w, long m) {
        if (w <= 3) return true;
        if (m == 1) return true;
        
        return checkRecursive(w, m - 1) || checkRecursive(w, m) || checkRecursive(w, m + 1);
    }
    
    static boolean checkRecursive(long w, long m) {
        if (m <= 0) return false;
        if (m % w != 0) return false;
        return check(w, m / w);
    }
}

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Main().run();
    }
    
    void run() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long w = sc.nextLong();
        long m = sc.nextLong();
        System.out.println(solve(w, m) ? "YES" : "NO");
    }
    
    boolean solve(long w, long m) {
        if (w <= 3 || m == 1) return true;
        
        return Stream.of(m - 1, m, m + 1)
            .filter(x -> x > 0)
            .anyMatch(x -> x % w == 0 && solve(w, x / w));
    }
}
